messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Unable to print fit in PyStan
parts:
Hi Christopher,

PyStan's extract() is much slower than RStan's and it has problems with large
numbers of parameters. In short, PyStan makes copies of all the parameters when
it doesn't strictly need to. I'm working on a fix as we speak.

For now, I'd recommend using extract() by itself (which is slow but it shouldn't
stall) or using CmdStan.

Best wishes,

-a

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Unable to print fit in PyStan
parts:
Hi Jesse,

Extract and summary might be somewhat slow for large (1,000+ parameter) models,
but they should not be extremely slow (i.e., no more than a few seconds or tens
of seconds).

RStan does the rhat and ess calculations used in summary in C++ so it's faster
than PyStan. There's an issue tracking this: https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/issues/21

Thanks,

Allen
